details.body: Ubiquitous, a. sarvagata, sarvavyApin.
UBIQUITOUS: (1) sarvavyApin (f. nI) (= all- -pervading);(2) sarvagataH (tA, taM), Ku. v. 58.
UBIQUITY: sarvagatatvam: v. Omnipresence etc.
Udder, s. UDas n., ApInaM, stanaM, (mostly human); ‘having pot-like u(dder)s’ GawoDnI; ‘having large u(dder)s’ pInoDnI.
UDDER: (1) U(u)Das (n.), with large u. s: pInoDna (f. DnI);(2) ApInam;(3) stanaH (gen. human). “U. less lambs”: stanyahInA mezaSAvAH.

UDDER , s. UDas n., uDas n., oDas n., oDaH, UDasaM, uDasaM, ApInaM, vARaH, vAmaH; ‘of a cow,’ gostanaH; ‘of a bitch,’ SunIstanaH, sunAraH. Obs. UDas becomes Upan in comp.; as, ‘a cow with a full udder,’ pInoDnI, pIvarastanI; ‘with an udder like a well,’ kuRqoDnI.
UGLINESS: I Lit.:(1) vErUpyam, with super- fluous u.: vErUpyapOnaruktayena, R. xii. 40.;(2) kurUpatA;(3) kadAkAratA;(4) anaBirUpatA;(5) vikftatA.II Badness: kutsitatA.
UGLINESS , s. kurUpatA, virUpatA, vErUpyaM, aparUpatA, asOndaryyaM, AlAvaRyaM, asOmyatA, kutsitAkAratA, asOzWavaM.
Ugly, a. ku-vi-apa-rUpa, vikfta, kadAkAra; durdarSana, vikftAkAra. 2 kutsita, niMdya. [Ugl]iness, s. vErupyaM, aparUpatA, kadAkAraH.
UGLY: I Lit.:(1) kadAkAra (f. rA);(2) kurUpa (f. pA);(3) virUpa (f. pA): v. Deformed.II Bad: q. v.: kutsita (f. tA); u. wound: kutsitaM vraRam, (comp. Bengali).

UGLY , a. kurUpaH -pA -pI -paM, aparUpaH &c., virUpaH &c., rUpahInaH -nA -naM, kadAkAraH -rA -raM, kutsitAkAraH &c., kutsitaH -tA -taM, kutsi- tAkftiH -tiH -ti, asundaraH -rA -rI -raM, asOmyaH -myA -myaM, durdarSanaH -nA -naM, vikftAkAraH &c.; ‘an ugly woman,’ kustrI.

Ulcer, s. pUyavraRaH-RaM, vidraDiH, nAqIvraRaH-RaM, pUyakzataM. [Ulcer]ate, v. t. vraRaM utpad c. v. i. sakzatIBU 1 P, vraRaM baMD 9 P. [Ulcer]ated, [Ulcer]ous, a. pUyavraRin, savraRa, sakzata, upahata in comp. with (s.).
ULCER: (1) pUyavraRam;(2) vidraDiH (= abscess); (3) nAqIvraRam (a deep u.).
ULCER , s. vraRaH, kzataM, nAQIkzaRaH, sapUyakzataM, pUtivraRaH, raktavidraDiH m., utsaNgI m. (n); ‘bottom of one,’ utsaNgaH.
To ULCERATE , v. n. savraRIBU, savrawIBU, vraRitaH -tA -taM BU, vraRaM banD.
To ULCERATE , v. a. vraRaM kf, savraRIkf, kzataM kf, praRam utpad in caus.
ULCERATED, ULCEROUS: (1) pUyavraRin (f. RI); (2) pUyavraRopahata (f. tA); etc.
ULCERATED , ULCEROUS, a. savraRI -RinI -Ri (n), vraRitA -tA -taM, savraRaH -Ra -RaM, rAkzataH -tA -taM, jAtavraRaH -RA -RaM, vraRamayaH -yI -yaM.
ULCERATION , s. vraRitvaM -tA, savraRa vaH, sakzataBAvaH, vraRabanDanaM.
Ulterior, a. uttara, apara; See Distant.
ULTERIOR: uttara (f. rA = succeeding): v. Also remote.
ULTERIOR , a. uttaraH -rA -raM, aparaH &c., pAScAtyaH -tyA -tyaM.
Ultimate, a. carama, aMtima See Last. [Ultimate]ly, adv. aMte, Seze, aMtataH. Ultimatum, s. caramABisaMDiH, aMtyapratijYA.
ULTIMATE: carama (f. mA): v. Last, final.
ULTIMATE , a. antimaH -mA -maM, caramaH &c. See LAST, FINAL.
ULTIMATELY: antataH: v. Lastly.
ULTIMATELY , adv. antatas, ante, Seze, Sezatas. See LASTLY.
ULTIMATUM: caramABisanDiH, and sim. comp. s.
ULTIMATUM , s. antyapratijYA, antyavAkyaM, nidAnavAkyaM.
Ultra, a. ex. by ati in comp.
ULTRA: I = excessive: ati- in comp., u.- democrat: atiprajAtantrin (f. RI).II Beyond: pAra- in comp., u. marine: samudrapArIRa (f. RA); u. montane: parvatapArIRa (f. RA); etc.
ULTRA , s. atyantaH -ntA -ntaM, ekAntaH &c. See EXCESSIVE.
Ultra-marine, a. dvIpAMtaraBava.
UMĀ , s. (Wife of Śiva) umA, satI, see DURGĀ.
UMBEL, UMBELLA: *pratatasavakaH.
Umbilical, a. nABya, nABi in comp.; ‘a cord’ nABi f., -nAlaH.
UMBILICAL: (1) nABi- in comp., u. cord: nABinAlam, R. v. 7.;(2) nABya (f. ByA).
UMBILICAL , a. nAByaH -ByA -ByaM, nABisambanDI &c.; ‘umbilical cord, nABiH f., nAlaH, nABinAqI, nABinAlA, garBanAqI; ‘section of it,’ nABicCedanaM; ‘region,’ nABimaRqalaM.
Umbra, s. pUrRacCAyA.
Umbrage, s. CAyA. 2 aprIti f., kopaH, asaMtozaH, aparADaH; ‘take u(mbrage)’ pra-, kup 4 P. Angry, q. v.; ‘give u(mbrage)’ virAgaM nI 1 P; See Insult.
UMBRAGE: I Lit.: CAyA.II Resentment: q. v.: asantozaH. Ph.: to take u.: kupyati (kup, c. 4.); to give u.: viraYjayati (raYj, c. 10.).
UMBRAGE , s. asantozaH, atuzwiH f., aprItiH f.; ‘to take umbrage,’ asantuzwaH -zwA -zwaM BU, prakup (c. 4. -kupyati).
Umbrella, s. CatraM, AtapatraM, GarmavAraRaM, jalatraM.
UMBRELLA: (1) Catram (state) or CatrA (common), an u. of peacock's tail: mayUrapicCamayI CatrikA, K. ii.;(2) Atapatram;(3) GarmavAraRam, Ku. xiv. 3.
UMBRELLA , s. CatraM, jalatrA, vAritrA, AtapatraM, AtapavAraRaM, vastrakuwwimaM, kAvArI; ‘state-umbrella,’ CatraM; ‘bearer of it,’ CatraDArI m. (n).
Umpire, s. maDyasTaH, nirRetf m.
UMPIRE: (1) mavyasTa (f. sTA);(2) maDyama (f. mA), R. xiii. 7.
UMPIRE , s. maDyasTaH, sTeyaH, pramARapuruzaH, SaWaH.

Un, A prefix, ex. by a (an before vowels), sometimes by nir, vi, dus pr., hIna, rahita in comp.; ‘unaided’ asahAya, sAhAyyahIna; ‘undaunted’ nirBIka, aBaya; ‘unmixed’ a-miSra; ‘unwelcome’ apriya, anaBimata &c.; ‘unattainable’ duzprApa (In cases where the word formed with ‘un’ is not given, the student should take the simple word or form it, and use the above prefixes. With nouns the sense of ‘un’ may be expressed by apa-nI 1 P, or hf 1 P; e. g. ‘unbar’ argalaM apanI, niragalIkf &c.).
UN: (1) a- (an- before vowels) in comp.; (2) nir- in comp.;(3) vi- in comp. (rare): v. Also devoid of.

UN . This prefix is expressed in Sanskrit by a, an, nir, vi, apa, dur &c., prefixed, or by hIna, rahita, SUnya &c., affixed. In cases where the English word formed with ‘un’ is not given in this Dictionary, the student must take the simple noun and use one of the above prefixes or affixes.
UNABASHED: (1) nihrIkaH (kA, kaM);(2) nirllajja (f. jjA): v. Also shameless.
UNABATED: akzIRa (f. RA): v. Undiminished.
UNABLE: (1) aSakta (f. ktA);(2) asamarTa (f. rTA);(3) akzamaH (mA, maM);(4) anISa (f. SA): v. Able, can.
UNABLE , a. aSaktaH -ktA -ktaM, asamarTaH -rTA -rTaM, akzamaH -mA -maM, anISaH -SA -SaM, akalpaH -lpA -lpaM, apArakaH -kA -kaM.
UNACCENTED: anudAtta (f. ttA).
UNACCENTED , a. anudAttaH -ttA -ttaM, asvaritaH -tA -taM.
UNACCEPTABLE: (1) agrAhya (f. hyA);(2) apari- grAhya (f. hyA);(3) apratigrAhya, (f. hyA);(4) agrahaRIya (f. yA); etc.
UNACCEPTABLE , a. apratigrAhyaH -hyA -hyaM, agrAhyaH &c., agrahaRIyaH &c., anAdeyaH -yA -yaM, asvIkAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, alIkaH -kA -kaM.
UNACCOMPANIED: (1) asahAya (f. yA);(2) advitIya (f. yA): v. Alone.
UNACCOMPANIED , a. asahAyaH -yA -yaM, asahAyavAn -vatI -vat (t), asahAyI -yinI -yi (n), asaNgaH -NgA -NgaM, ekAkI &c.
UNACCOMPLISHED: (1) anizpanna (f. nnA);(2) asamAhita (f. tA); etc.

UNACCOMPLISHED , a. asADitaH -tA -taM, asidDaH -dDA -dDaM, asaMsidDaH &c., asampannaH -nnA -nnaM, anizpannaH &c., anupapannaH &c., asamAptaH -ptA -ptaM, anaDigataH -tA -taM, akftaH &c., anAgatavAn &c., asampUrRaH &c.
Unaccustomed, a. aparicita, anaByasta, anuanuBUta.
UNACCUSTOMED: (1) aparicita (f. tA);(2) anaBijYa (f. jYA = unacquainted);(3) ananuBUta (f. tA = unfelt), u. to ornaments: ananuButaBuzaRa (f. RA), Sa. iv.
UNACCUSTOMED , a. anaByastaH -stA -staM, anaByAsI &c., akftAByAsaH -sA -saM; ‘to ornament,’ ananuBUtaBUzaRaH -RA -RaM.
UNACKNOWLEDGED: (1) apratipanna (f. nnA);(2) anamyupeta (f. tA), etc.: v. To acknow- -ledge.
UNACKNOWLEDGED , a. ananujYAtaH -tA -taM, anaNgIkftaH -tA -taM.
UNACQUAINTED: (1) anaBijYa (f. jYA): v. Acquainted.
UNACQUAINTED , a. anaBijYaH -jYA -jYaM, aparicitaH &c., see IGNORANT.
UNACTIONABLE: (1) avyavahArya (f. ryA);(2) vyavahArAyogya (f. gyA), etc.
UNACTIONABLE , a. avyavahAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, vyavahArAvizayaH -yA -yaM.
UNADORNED: analaNkfta (f. tA): v. Adorn, ornament.
UNADORNED , a. analaNkftaH -tA -taM, aBUzitaH &c., alaNkArahInaH &c.
UNADULTERATED: (1) asaMmiSra (f. SrA);(2) viSudDa (f. dDA = pure).
UNADULTERATED , a. adUzitaH -tA -taM, amiSritaH &c., asaMsfzwaH &c.
UNADVISED: expr. by part. s asamIkzya or avivicya.
Unaffected, a. akftrima, sahaja, avyAja; See Artless.
UNAFFECTED: I Unmoved: nirdaya (f. yA): v. Hard, unkind.II Unfeigned, sincere: q. v.: akftrima (f. mA).III Not influenced: (1) anaBiBUta (f. tA);(2) aspfzwa (f. zwA).
UNAFFECTED , a. (Not acted upon) anupahataH -tA -taM, apratihataH &c., nirvikAraH -rA -raM, avikftaH -tA -taM. — (Unfeigned) akftrimaH -mA -maM, see SINCERE, SIMPLE. — (Unmoved) ajAtadravaH -vA -vaM.
UNAFFECTEDLY: (1) amAyayA;(2) avElakzyeRa: v. Sincerely.
UNAFFECTEDLY , adv. avElakzyeRa, avilakzatvena, sAralyena, amAyayA.
UNAIDED: (1) asahAya (f. yA);(2) niHsahAya (f. yA);(3) sAhAyyahIna (f. nA); etc.
UNAIDED , a. anupakftaH -tA -taM, asahAyaH -yA -yaM, niHsahAyaH &c.
UNALIENABLE: (1) aviSlezya (f. zyA);(2) nirviGawanIya (f. yA);(3) ahArya (f. ryA).
UNALIENABLE , a. anyAdeyaH -yA -yaM, sTAvaraH &c., see INALIENABLE.
UNALLOYED: (1) asaMmiSra (f. SrA = unmixed); (2) SudDa (f. dDA), vi- (= pure: q. v.).
UNALLOYED , a. aviGnaH -GnA -GnaM, nirviGnaH &c., anizwAmiSraH &c.
UNALTERABLE: (1) avikArya (f. ryA = immov- able);(2) ahArya (f. ryA = immovable): v. Constant, fixed.
UNALTERABLE , a. avikAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM. See IMMUTABLE.
UNALTERED , a. avikAraH -rA -raM, nirvikAraH &c., avikftaH -tA -taM.
UNAMBIGUOUS: asandigDa (f. gDA): v. Un- -doubted, clear.
UNAMIABLE: apriya (f. yA): v. Amiable, pleasant.
UNAMIABLE , a. apriyaH -yA -yaM, aprItijanakaH -kA -kaM.
UNANIMITY: (1) Ekamatyam;(2) ekacittatA;(3) Ekyam (= unity).
UNANIMITY , s. EkamatyaM, cittEkyaM, matEkyaM, ekacittatA.

Unanimous, a. ekamata-citta. [Unanimous]ly, adv. ekacittIBUya, Ekamatyena. Unanimity, s. EkamatyaM, citta-mata-EkyaM, ekacittatA; asmin vizaye sarvezAmEkamatyaM ‘there is a u(nanimity) on this point’.
UNANIMOUS: (1) ekamata (f. tA);(2) ekacitta (f. ttA);(3) by subs., about this the Śāstras are u.: SAstrARAmatrEkamatyam. H. i.
UNANIMOUS , a. ekacittaH -ttA -ttaM, ekamataH -tA -taM, sarvvasammataH &c.
UNANIMOUSLY: (1) ekacittIBUya;(2) Ekamatyena; (3) by circumlo., u. cried out: ekavAkyaM vivavruH R. vi. 85.
UNANIMOUSLY , adv. ekacittIBUya, ekamatIBUya, matEkyena.
UNANSWERABLE: I Irrefutable: niruttara (f. rA). II Not responsible: adAyin (f. nI), (?).
UNANSWERABLE , a. anuttaraH -rA -raM, duruttaraH &c., aKaRqanIyaH &c.
UNAPPALLED: apaBayaH (yA, yaM): v. Undaunt- -ed, fearless.
UNAPPEASED: aprasanna (f. nnA): v. To appease, satisfy.
UNAPPROACHABLE: I Lit.: agamya (f. myA): v. Inaccessible.II Fig.: durupagamya (f. myA): v. Also unrivalled.

UNAPPROACHABLE , a. agamyaH -myA -myaM, anAgamyaH &c., anaBigamanIyaH &c., agamanIyaH &c., durgamaH -mA -maM, durupasTAnaH -nA -naM, anupasAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, durDarzaH -rzA -rzaM, agaH -gA -gaM. See INACCESSIBLE.
UNAPT: (1) ayogya (f. gyA): v. Unsuitable; akuSala (f. lA): v. Unskilful.
UNAPT , a. ayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, anAptaH -ptA -ptaM, akuSalaH -lA -laM.
UNAPTLY: (1) akuSalam;(2) adakzam; etc.
Unarmed, a. viSastra, nirAyuDa, asajja.
UNARMED: aSastra (f. strA); (2) nirAyuDa (f. DA); (3) viSastra (f. strA), and sim. comp. s.

UNARMED , a. aSastraH -strA -straM, viSastraH &c., niHSastraH &c., SastrahInaH -nA -naM, SastrarahitaH -tA -taM, astrahInaH &c., nirAyuDaH -DA -DaM, anAyuDaH &c., anAyudDaH -dDA -dDaM, asajjaH -jjA -jjaM, asajjitaH -tA -taM, asannadDaH &c., nirhetiH -tiH -ti; ‘unarmed state,’ vESastraM
UNASKED: (1) apfzwa (f. zwA);(2) ayAcita (f. tA): v. To ask.
UNASKED , a. apfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, ayAcitaH -tA -taM, apracoditaH &c.
UNASPIRATED: alpaprARa (f. RA).
UNASPIRATED , a. alpaprARaH -RA -RaM, alpaprARoccAritaH &c.
UNASPIRING (adj.): (1) nirAkANkza (f. NkzA);(2) niHspfha (f. hA); etc.
Unassailable, a. duzpraDarza, aDfzya, durAsada.
UNASSAILABLE: (1) aDfzya (f. zyA), Ku. iii. 51.;(2) duzpraDarza (f. rzA), R. ii. 27. and sim. comp. s.
UNASSAILABLE , a. anAkramaRIyaH -yA -yaM, anAkramyaH -myA -myaM.
UNASSISTED , a. anupakftaH -tA -taM, asahAyaH -yA -yaM, niHsahAyaH &c.
UNASSOCIATED , a. asahitaH -tA -taM, asaNgaH -NgA -NgaM, niHsaNgaH &c.
Unassuming, a. avikatTana, adfpta, vinIta; See Humble.
UNASSUMING: namra (f. mrA): v. Humble.
UNASSUMING , a. apragalBaH -lBA -lBaM, anaBimAnI -ninI &c., nirgarvaH -rvA -rvaM, avikatTanaH -nA -naM, akatTanaH &c., vinItaH -tA -taM, niBftaH &c.
UNASSUMINGLY: (1) by adj.;(2) namrIBUya; (3) vinItavat.
UNASSURED: I Adj.: aniScita (f. tA): v. Uncertain.II Adv.:(1) aniScitya;(2) avijYAya.
UNATTAINABLE: (1) duzprApya (f. pyA);(2) alamya (f. ByA);(3) durAsada (f. dA); etc.: v. To attain, get.

UNATTAINABLE , a. aprApyaH -pyA -pyaM, alaByaH -ByA -ByaM, agamyaH -myA -myaM, anaDigamyaH &c., anAsAdyaH -dyA -dyaM, duzprApaH -pA -paM, kazwaprApyaH &c., durAsadaH -dA -daM, asADyaH -DyA -DyaM, durgamaH -mA -maM, agamaH &c.
UNATTENDED: (1) asahAya (f. yA);(2) asahAyin (f. nI): v. Also alone.

UNATTENDED , a. asahAyI -yinI -yi (n), asahAyavAn -vatI -vat (t), niranucaraH -rA -raM, ananucaraH &c., anucararahitaH -tA -taM, anucarahInaH -nA -naM, niranugaH -gA -gaM, asahitaH -tA -taM, vipAlaH -lA -laM, nirgra- nTakaH &c.
UNATTESTED: (1) by circumlo.: v. To attest; (2) apramARita (f. tA = unauthenticated).
UNATTESTED , a. asAkzikaH -kI -kaM, sAkzyahInaH -nA -naM, apramARaH &c.
UNAUTHENTIC , a. aprAmARikaH -kI -kaM, apramARayuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
UNAUTHENTICATED: (1) apramARita (f. tA); (2) aprAmARika (f. kI); etc.
UNAUTHORITATIVE , a. nizpramARaH -RA -RaM, anAptaH -ptA -ptaM.
UNAUTHORIZED: (1) aniyukta (f. ktA);(2) niranumata (f. tA); etc.
UNAUTHORIZED , a. aprAmARikaH -kI -kaM, viDihInaH -nA -naM.
Unavailing, a. nirarTaka, nirguRa, nizPala.
UNAVAILING (adj.): nizPala (f. lA): v. Ineffectual.
UNAVAILING , a. vyarTaH -rTA -rTaM, nizPalaH &c. See INEFFECTUAL.
UNAVOIDABLE: (1) anatikramaRIya (f. yA);(2) aparihArya (f. ryA); etc.
UNAVOIDABLE , a. aparihAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, anatikramaRIyaH -yA -yaM, ani- vAryyaH &c., aSakyanivAraH -rA -raM; ‘decree,’ ahAryyayogaH.
Unawares, adv. atarkitaM, alakzitaM, niBftaM, akasmAt; See Suddenly also.
UNAWARES: (1) atarkitam;(2) alakzitam: v. Also suddenly.
UNAWARES , adv. akasmAt, acintitaM, atarkitaM. See SUDDENLY.
UNBAKED: (1) apakva (f. kvA);(2) Ama (f. mA).
UNBAKED , a. apakvaH -kvA -kvaM, AmaH -mA -maM, akAndavaH &c. To UNBAR, v. a. nirargalIkf, anargalIkf, argalam apanI or hf.
Unbar, Unbolt, v. t. nirargalayati (D.).
UNBAR: (1) nirargalayati (nomi.): v. Bar, to remove.
UNBEARABLE: asahya (f. hyA): v. Intolerable, insufferable.
UNBEARABLE , a. asahyaH -hyA -hyaM, asahanIyaH &c., see INTOLERABLE.
UNBEATEN , a. akzuRRaH -RRA -RRaM; ‘path,’ akzuRRamArgaH.
UNBECOMING: (1) avinIta (f. tA = indecor- -ous);(2) anucita (f. tA = improper).
UNBECOMING , a. ayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, ayogyaH &c. See INDECOROUS.
UNBELIEF: aviSvAsaH: v. Disbelief, infidelity.
UNBELIEF , s. aviSvAsaH, aSradDA, aBaktiH f. See INFIDELITY.
Unbeliever, s. nAstikaH, -budDiH, pAKaMqaH, miTyAdfzwiH.
Unbend, v. t. SiTilIkf 8 U; See Relax. [Unbend]ing, a. Cruel, q. v.
UNBEND: I Lit.: saralIkaroti.II To relax: SiTilayati (nomi.).
UNBENDING (adj.): durAnamya (f. myA): v. Also hard, cruel.
UNBENT , p. p. anataH -tA -taM, unnataH &c., aBugnaH &c., see RELAXED.
UNBIASSED: anAvarjita (f. tA): v. Impartial.
UNBIASSED , a. samadfzwiH -zwiH -zwi, saNgahInaH &c. See IMPARTIAL.
UNBIDDEN: (1) acodita (f. tA);(2) anAjYapta (f. ptA); etc.
UNBIDDEN , a. animantritaH -tA -taM, apracoditaH &c., anAjYaptaH &c.
Unbind, v. t. ud-graMT 9 P, SiTilIkf 8 U.
UNBIND: mocayati (muc, c. 10.): v. To loosen, free.
To UNBIND , v. a. udgranT, SiTilIkf. See To LOOSE, v. a.
UNBLAMABLE, UNBLAMED: anindya (f. ndyA): v. Blameless.
UNBLAMABLE , a. anavadyaH -dyA -dyaM, anindanIyaH -yA -yaM, anindyaH &c., avAcyaH -cyA -cyaM, niraparADaH -DA -DaM, anupaskftaH &c. See INNOCENT.
UNBLEACHED: u. cloth: nizpravARiH or nizpravARam.

USE (subs.): I Employment, application: (1) prayogaH, u. of words: padaprayogaH, N. xxii. 84.; popular u. is of more force than grammar: vyAkaraRAlloke prayoga eva balIyAn, Com.;(2) vyavahAraH, making u. of signs on account of deaf- ness: vaDiratayA saMjYAvyavahArin (f. Object, purpose. Ph.: to be of u., i. e. useful: q. v.

USE , s.
